text_block_list.text:
After a training briefing session, I hand
Mihono
Bourbon a fan letter that arrived
for her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I will read it now.

The letter gushes over Mihono Bourbon's
running
and how inspiring the hard work
she puts in is.

"Dear Bourbon... I'm going to work just
as hard as
you do. And someday..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be strong, just like you."
...Like me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Increased heart rate confirmed. Body

temperature rising rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...This is not according to schedule, but

requesting permission to run.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in order to burn off this
excess
energy.

And so, I end up going for a run with
Mihono
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm accumulating fatigue as I run... but
the
thermal energy in my chest continues
to increase.

Though I harbor some concerns about
her health,
I stay with the impassioned
Mihono Bourbon right
up until curfew!
